article_title: 'Fantastic' moment blind Abergavenny veteran, 95, drives again

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: A charity event giving blind and visually impaired people the chance to drive safely on a racetrack
A government plan to return driving licences to everyone over 90
A competition between professional racing drivers in Wales
A new medical treatment that restores eyesight
tasks.correct_answer: A charity event giving blind and visually impaired people the chance to drive safely on a racetrack
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת באירוע של עמותת Speed of Sight, המאפשר לאנשים עיוורים ולקויי ראייה לחוות נהיגה בטוחה במסלול.

tasks.prompt: Why did Jim Alison have to give up his driving licence?
options: He moved away from London
His eyesight deteriorated because of macular degeneration
He stopped working for the Royal Engineers
His car was not suitable for the circuit
tasks.correct_answer: His eyesight deteriorated because of macular degeneration
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ג׳ים ויתר על רישיונו לאחר שראייתו הידרדרה בגלל ניוון מקולרי והוא הוכר כעיוור.

tasks.prompt: How was Jim able to drive safely at Llandow Circuit?
options: He drove alone using a map
He followed another car by sound
He drove beside an instructor in a car with dual controls
He stayed below 10 km/h in the parking area
tasks.correct_answer: He drove beside an instructor in a car with dual controls
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ג׳ים נהג לצד מדריך וברכב בעל שליטה כפולה, כך שהמדריך יכול היה להתערב בעת הצורך.

tasks.prompt: Why did the instructor let Jim control the car mainly on the straight section?
options: The car could not turn left
Jim could not see the bends in the track
The charity allowed only former chauffeurs to turn
The track was closed everywhere else
tasks.correct_answer: Jim could not see the bends in the track
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ג׳ים הסביר שבשל לקות הראייה אינו יכול לראות את הפניות, ולכן קיבל שליטה בעיקר בקטע הישר.

tasks.prompt: What does “deteriorated” mean when the article describes Jim's eyesight?
options: Improved quickly
Became worse over time
Was measured by an instructor
Changed only while driving
tasks.explanation_hebrew: deteriorated פירושו הידרדר או נעשה גרוע יותר עם הזמן.

tasks.prompt: What does “empowers” mean in Mike Newman's description of the charity?
options: Gives people confidence, ability and a sense of control
Provides electricity to the racing cars
Requires participants to become professional drivers
Removes the need for safety instructors
tasks.correct_answer: Gives people confidence, ability and a sense of control
tasks.explanation_hebrew: empowers פירושו מחזק אנשים ומעניק להם ביטחון, יכולת ותחושת שליטה.

tasks.prompt: Describe Jim Alison's background and his experience at the Speed of Sight event.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול לפחות חמש עובדות מדויקות על עברו, אובדן הראייה והנהיגה במסלול.
expected_points: Jim Alison is 95 and from Abergavenny
He served with the Royal Engineers for 22 years
He later worked as a driver or chauffeur in London
Macular degeneration caused his eyesight to deteriorate
He gave up his licence after being registered blind five years earlier
He drove at Llandow Circuit with an instructor and dual controls
He estimated reaching about 90 km/h or 55 mph
He described the experience as fantastic

tasks.prompt: How does the event provide both excitement and safety for participants with visual impairments?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר לפחות שני אמצעי בטיחות ושתי דוגמאות לחוויה הרגשית המתוארת.
expected_points: The driving takes place on a controlled racetrack
Cars have dual controls so instructors can intervene
Jim drove mainly on the straight because he could not see bends
Dean received one tap on the leg to accelerate and two to brake
Participants experienced speed and adrenaline
Harley described happiness, excitement and wonder
Dean said the experience restored freedom and confidence

tasks.prompt: Summarise how Speed of Sight began and what it offers people with disabilities.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את מייק ניומן, הקמת העמותה, התאמות הרכב והשפעת האירוע על המשתתפים.
expected_points: Mike Newman was born blind and loved motorsports
He was told that becoming a racing driver was impossible
He went on to set several driving world records
He founded Speed of Sight in 2012
The charity helps people who cannot normally drive experience a racetrack
It uses modified Mazda MX5 cars with dual controls
Cars are named after some of Newman's guide dogs
Participants describe enjoyment, adrenaline, freedom and confidence
People of different ages and backgrounds can participate

tasks.prompt: Write a short invitation to a future Speed of Sight event that is inspiring but accurate about safety and accessibility.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב באנגלית, לתאר את החוויה באופן חיובי ולכלול לפחות שלושה פרטי בטיחות או נגישות מן הכתבה.
expected_points: State that the event welcomes people with disabilities or visual impairments
Explain that driving takes place on a racetrack
Mention trained instructors
Mention dual-control adapted cars
Describe the excitement without promising complete independence
Refer to participants such as Jim, Harley or Dean without inventing facts
Highlight confidence or enjoyment
Avoid claiming that participants receive a normal road licence
